provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: With all scalar Casimir graph currents assigned (d,d-1), the HL diagonal sets these currents and positive jets to zero. The potential lies in the square of the basic invariant ideal, so its slice derivatives vanish modulo the restricted invariants. The diagonal ring is therefore the nilcone intersected with the Slodowy slice. Flatness of the restricted adjoint quotient gives the regular sequence of basic Casimirs.
provenance.invariant_square_reason: Every active potential monomial has at least two basic Casimir factors.
provenance.method: Adjoint sl2 branching and the nilcone-slice complete intersection; two exact expansion algorithms
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal for the scalar Casimir graph presentation. Does not compute full Macdonald, establish physical filtration uniqueness, locate a jump or extend Schur validation. Extended to the fixed predicted jump q order; no Macdonald or Schur cutoff change.
provenance.stored_macdonald_arithmetic: Finite-field calculation: finite field F_1000003; stored integer coefficients compared with independent references
provenance.variable_convention: z^2 = t = qT; degrees in the rational function are z degrees

predicted_jump_review.summary: The nonconstant parameter pullback embeds QQ(a) into the finite field extension QQ(s). The displayed invertible diagonal grading-preserving coordinate map changes the generic potential into a nonzero coefficient-field unit times the physical potential. The chain rule identifies their gradient ideals. Every jet prolongation is block triangular with invertible diagonal Jacobian. Field extension preserves graded ranks and Betti numbers, proving equality for all finite jets, not just the checked strand. This is a reviewed principal exception, not a blanket Higgsed exemption.
